milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate within 5 blocks of the potted red tulip (at spawn-relative 5,1,6 inside the stone brick shelter) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the target object.

scene_description: A grass field with two small structures. The main structure is a stone brick shelter (5x3 footprint) with an oak slab roof containing a potted red tulip, a crafting table, and an oak plank block. A secondary cobblestone enclosure behind the player contains a potted dandelion as a distractor. A lantern is placed nearby for ambient detail. The player must explore and enter the stone brick shelter to find the potted red tulip.
task_text: Find the potted red tulip. Explore the structures in the area and locate the potted red tulip flower.
design_notes: The potted red tulip is at relative position ~5 ~1 ~6 (inside the stone brick shelter). The shelter entrance is a 2-block-wide doorway on the south face (z=5 side). The distractor potted dandelion is at ~-4 ~1 ~-4 in a cobblestone enclosure behind the player. The player spawns at ~0 ~1 ~0 facing the shelter direction. The scene is compact within 8 blocks of spawn in all directions.
